author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

In the context of investigating ROOT header parsing triggered by https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51200#issuecomment-5735081507, this PR adds ROOT dictionaries for types that would otherwise cause ROOT to parse headers (that incurs memory cost etc).

In addition the dictionary for `std::unordered_map<uint32_t, double>` is moved to `DataFormats/StdDictionaries` (which is the correct place for `std`-only dictionaries not defined in ROOT itself).

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2444

#### PR validation:

Code compiles, and according to `gdb` with a breakpoint in ROOT's `ExecAutoParse` there is less header parsing going on.
title: Add missing dictionaries
